defs.def: a building in which films/movies are shown 电影院

ex.s: Some of his other works were also adapted for cinema, including The Deep, The Island and White Shark.Benchley later regretted writing sensationalist work about sharks, and became a strong advocate for marine conservation.
ex.t: 他的一些其他作品也被改编成电影，包括《深海》、《岛屿》和《白鲨》。本奇利后来后悔写了关于鲨鱼的耸人听闻的作品，并成为海洋保护的坚定倡导者。

ex.s: (Student B) I've won a free cinema ticket.
ex.t: （学生B ）我赢了一张免费电影票。

ex.s: The Tramp is a symbol of the silent cinema and even after so many years, he is still able to make people laugh.
ex.t: 流浪汉是无声电影的象征，即使经过这么多年，他仍然能够让人们发笑。

ex.s: In London, my home is very close to museums, the zoo, cinemas and community centres, so I have lots to do in my free time.
ex.t: 在伦敦，我的房源非常靠近博物馆、动物园、电影院和社区中心，因此我在业余时间有很多事情要做。

ex.s: I fed cows, goats andchickens,andevenlearntto ridea horse.Youdon't needto visit museums,cinemas or community centres because you can explore forests,cavesandbeaches.Ididn't miss going online because I was too busy connecting with nature!
ex.t: 我喂奶牛、山羊和鸡，甚至学会骑马。您不需要参观博物馆、电影院或社区中心，因为您可以探索森林、洞穴和海滩。不要错过上网的机会，因为我太忙于与大自然交流了！

defs.def: when you go to the cinema or to the movies, you go to a cinema/movie theater to see a film/movie （去电影院）看电影
